messages:
erin: quick heads-up: new user reports TS can't find declarations when using the edge sample (vite). Error: "Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'".

tom: classic export-map/type resolution mismatch. do we still only have top-level "types" without per-export types?

erin: yep, installed package.json shows: 
{ "exports": { ".": { "import": "dist/index.mjs", "require": "dist/index.cjs" }, "./runtime": { "edge": "dist/edge.mjs" } }, "types": "dist/index.d.ts" }

vik: that layout often breaks TS/bundlers that evaluate conditional exports. The fix is to add a "types" field under each export key (and ensure the .d.ts files are published).

luisa: small checklist: 1) add per-export "types" pointers, 2) include dist/*.d.ts in package files, 3) add a smoke tsc --noEmit in sample-app CI.

tom: also add an "import" fallback for ./runtime (so edge and browser flows both resolve to an ESM that has a paired .d.ts). e.g. "./runtime": { "types": "dist/runtime.d.ts", "import": "dist/runtime.mjs", "edge": "dist/edge.mjs" }

erin: I reproduced locally by unpacking npm pack and the d.ts was missing in one published tarball (CI packlist issue). CI flagged it: pack-scan failed on v0.8.3.

ci-bot: pack-scan: missing dist/runtime.d.ts in release v0.8.3.

vik: I'll open a small PR to add exports/types + packlist fix + CI tsc smoke test. will include a tiny repro repo for support to point to.

luisa: pls add a short doc blurb in onboarding: "Edge runtimes: if TS complains after install, clear lockfile and ensure installed package contains dist/*.d.ts."

erin: thanks. after patching locally the vite sample's TS error went away. we should cut a patch once CI is green.

tom: agreed. follow-up: add a lint that verifies every export key has a types path or top-level types exists. saves future regressions.

ci-bot: PR pipeline queued.

erin: closing for now — will reopen if any stray reports after the patch.
